lines.quote: Designed a frequency-domain beamformer for a 32-element UHF receive array, optimised for real-time operation on the company's custom FPGA-plus-DSP platform

Embedded DSP in C/C++: wrote and optimised real-time beamforming kernels in C for the Tuulenkaari RX-32 receiver board (TI TMS320C6678 DSP), including fixed-point arithmetic routines and DMA-driven data transfer to meet 40 MHz throughput requirements

I ended up as the main person extending and maintaining it after the PhD student graduated, adding support for near-field probe data and integrating it with the group's version-controlled measurement archive.
the pipeline is still in daily use by four researchers

RF measurement: trained on and independently operated Rohde & Schwarz ZVA-40 vector network analysers for S-parameter characterisation of array feed networks, and conducted antenna pattern measurements using the Gotaalv antenna range during MSc thesis work

requirements.name: Team-lead experience
requirements.note: Cover letter explicitly describes only informal coordination of small project groups in a university setting, not formal team leadership; conservative status chosen per refuse-to-guess rule.

lines.quote: I published one first-author paper from my thesis work (SESE Antennas and Wireless Propagation Letters, 2024) on the phase-calibration method, and a co-authored conference paper at BaCAP 2024 on the prototype array's measured beam patterns.
I am a Finnish citizen with full EU work rights.
